# MalluChat

> MalluChat is the premier free Malayalam chatting website for Mallu stranger chat, Mallu video calling, and live Kerala chat rooms without registration.

## Primary Services

- [MalluChat Homepage](https://malluchat.live/): Main platform for anonymous Malayalam stranger chat and video calling.
- [Mallu Stranger Chat](https://malluchat.live/strangers-mallu-chat): Anonymous 1-on-1 text messaging and stranger video calling.
- [Mallu Free Video Calling Website](https://malluchat.live/mallu-free-video-call): High-definition peer-to-peer WebRTC voice and video calling.
- [Mallu Random Video Calling Website](https://malluchat.live/mallu-random-video-call): Single-click random matching with online Kerala strangers.
- [Mallu Chatting Website](https://malluchat.live/mallu-chatting-website): Live Kerala community chat lobbies and rooms.
- [Malayalam Chat Online](https://malluchat.live/malayalam-chat-online): Malayalam and Manglish group discussions.
- [Mallu Chat App](https://malluchat.live/mallu-chatting-app): Web-based progressive web application interface.
